findings: ETT.tex:1800-1804 (lem:J_int) holds at every E_{≥0}-manifold in the readings DEC-25, OQ-18, OQ-34/OQ-35 and OQ-82. It uses no strong causality, no connectedness, no Hausdorff and no second countability; T1 comes from the charts. Read at M with Z⁺(M) = M and Z⁻(M) = M ∖ sing₀(M) (rem:btz_pas_tarentin), it says Int J⁺(p) ∖ sing₀(M) = I⁺(p) and Int J⁻(p) = I⁻(p) for every p (Causal.SingularRowsLocal.J_int_sing). In particular Int J⁻(p) = ∅ at every BTZ point, which agrees with the curated finding on rem:pas_plat (ii). This instantiates the curated finding (the reduction to a causally convex chart at l.1805-1809 is not needed) at M. Non-vacuous at E₀ at every axis point (nonvacuous_e0), and at E_π (nonvacuous_epi), where sing₀ = ∅ and both signs read Int J^±(p) = I^±(p).

findings: ETT.tex:294, (ii) at M. I⁻(p) = ∅ holds at every BTZ point of every E_{≥0}-manifold, causal or not (Causal.SingularRowsLocal.Iminus_eq_empty). J⁻(p) = γ(]-∞, 0]), the half-line of the BTZ line below p, holds at every causal Hausdorff one (btz_past), in the readings DEC-25, OQ-18, OQ-34/OQ-35 and OQ-82. At a non-causal M only γ(]-∞, 0]) ⊆ J⁻(p) ⊆ the component is proved (btz_past_bounds). The printed sentence, which has no causality hypothesis, is the curated sentence-level finding on the defi:causal_E0 row (E₀ modulo a τ-translation, by hand, not formalized). It is not a new finding. By hand, as a sketch that is not formalized: the set equation J⁻(p) = γ(]-∞, 0]) holds with no causality as well. On a compact component γ is periodic, so both sides are the whole circle; otherwise the chart time is non-decreasing along a causal curve inside the line. What fails at non-causal M is « half-line », not the set equation. Non-vacuous at E₀ at every axis point, where γ is onto the whole axis (nonvacuous_e0, nonvacuous_e0_natural).

ETT.tex:290 and 294-295, the curated finding (« the BTZ defect is not a violation of defi:causalement_plat »), now at M: Int J⁻_U(A) = ∅ for every open U and every A ⊆ sing₀(M) (Causal.SingularRowsLocal.interior_Jminus_eq_empty, btz_causallyPlain_past), at every E_{≥0}-manifold, with no SingularFlatAxioms.

ETT.tex:290, « it fails in the two families of spacetimes this work exists to cover »: for the singular family this is refuted in the readings DEC-25, OQ-18, OQ-34/OQ-35 and OQ-82. Every E_{≥0}-manifold whose causality is absolutely minimal with an isomorphic chart at each point is causally plain, in both orientations, for every open U and every A (Causal.SingularRowsLocal.causallyPlain, from SFALocal.causallyPlain = causallyPlain_of_locZ with push-up, local Z⁺ and local Z⁻ off sing₀(M), which has empty interior). Its natural causality is one such causality (rows_of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25). Witness with BTZ points: E₀ is causally plain (nonvacuous_e0). The curated row says (ii) is « supported for (i) only » and covered the E₀-manifolds only (T-ett-sfa-local-e0: « the E_κ charts are not covered »). It now extends to every E_{≥0}-manifold, mixed ones included. This is evidence for OQ-16 (in these readings E_{≥0}-manifolds are causally plain), not a ruling. Suggested wording for l.290: « … and it fails in low regularity; at singularities only its relational form is at stake (… (ii) …) ».
